name: Rodge Andru P. Viloria
shortBio: Artist and designer working across digital illustration, graphic design, and poster composition.
fullBiography: Rodge Andru builds visual work with an editorial sensibility — fewer pieces, clearer intention, and careful presentation. The studio treats every image as an exhibition object: proportioned, paced, and left with room to breathe.
currentFocus: Curating a focused exhibition of illustration and poster work.
